ex.s: In southern Spain the sudden increase of greenhouses (which reflect light back to space) has changed the warming trend locally, and actually cooled the region.

ex.s: Furthermore, around 50% of the world’s population live in regions where the figure is now below the replacement level (ie 2.1 births per woman) and almost all developed nations are experiencing sub-replacement birth rate.

ex.t: 其次，虽然这个地区雨量充沛，但山势陡峭，土壤浅薄。

ex.s: Though there are many large, flat areas in the region, they built terraces on the mountains to have more areas to grow rice.
ex.t: 虽然该地区有许多大面积平坦的地方，但他们还是在山上修建了梯田，以便有更多的面积种植水稻。
